name: Bovine Milk (BMDB normal metabolome)
description: Bovine Milk medium from the Bovine Metabolome Database (BMDB) normal (healthy-subject) metabolite concentrations, mapped to BiGG exchanges, with a mineral base. Concentrations are medians of reported normal values (concentration_mM); original HMDB values retained per component.

provenance.citation: Bovine Metabolome Database (BMDB; Foroutan A et al., 2020, bovinedb.ca), normal bovine Milk concentrations. Primary refs PMID: 11132867, 11242448, 11286410, 1151503, 11556330, 11754544, 11913692, 12463694, 12667199, 12741556.
provenance.notes: Normal-condition concentrations only; medians across reports; units converted to mM where MW/units allowed. Presence-based uptake bounds; concentration_mM + hmdb_orig retained. Mineral base added.
provenance.source_identity_evidence: provenance.doi == '10.3390/metabo10060233' and citation contains 'Bovine Metabolome Database'

composition_provenance.definition: sourced = the cited source states this component; derived = the pipeline supplied it. Classification table: tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all divides components by (components + unresolved ingredients). It counts pipeline-derived components as covered, so it is not a measure of how much of the source's own ingredient list was captured. pct_covered_source divides source-stated components by (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components), which is that measure. Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
